gl_compatibility.manual_visual_review: Opening start, settled popup, closing start and mid reviewed across the two renderers, including compact scaling.

mobile.manual_visual_review: Opening start, settled popup, closing start and mid reviewed across the two renderers, including compact scaling.

limitations: No physical-device test or attachment check.
One containing-viewport readback per close; phone frame pacing remains unmeasured.
Close animation is for the embedded game popup; external native windows retain immediate dismissal.
No APK, live account/backend mutation, deployment, staging, commit or owner-process restart.
initial_findings: Direct popup texture disappears on native hide.
A temporary viewport copy did not retain visible popup pixels and was removed.
Capturing directly from the hidden popup target raises an empty-data error and was removed.
Initial scaled review clicks and crop bounds used the wrong coordinate space.
Initial PNG writes between motion frames distorted recorded timing; final frames are held in memory until the cycle ends.
Initial review restored a menu by synthetic click before native close callbacks settled; final review restores after settling and reruns all retained interaction assertions.

checkpoint_validation.initial_check_note: Zero-context documentation insertions require --unidiff-zero; initial checks without it rejected only these insertions.
